title: 第13章 美味值开启第14章 抵达庇护所
slug: 永恒降临全民开局末世求生
content_zh:
“对了，那个郑俊兴去哪了。”
赵敢当这才发现少了一个人。
起初还是三人被丧尸追，等到苏墨支援之时，只有苏婷和严梅两人在逃跑。
“他已经跑了。”
苏婷沉声开口。
赵敢当一脸不忿，“俺就知道他不是啥好人，一点男人气概都没有。”
苏墨倒是没什么感触，为了生存，不寒颤。
末世中，连手足相残之类的情况也屡见不鲜。
打扫完战场，赵敢当将丧尸的尸体都捡起扔到一旁，打算一把火烧了，苏墨连忙制止了他。
“丧尸烧掉会散发出一股恶臭的味道，而且这种味道很大，还会引来附近的丧尸。”
向赵敢当解释了一番原因，也相当于科普了，丧尸身上的肉可以归为腐肉，腐肉的味道可想而知。
看时间又是一天要过去了，苏墨决定找个地方建营火过夜，一场战斗过后，众人都有些疲倦，特别是苏婷和严梅，被丧尸追着跑了一路，根本走不动了。
苏墨一人四周探寻了一番，发现了一条小溪，决定今晚就待在小溪旁过夜了。
等到苏墨回去的时候，严梅已经醒了，看到苏墨她勉强笑了笑：“你，你回来了。”
“嗯，已经找好今晚过夜的地方了。”
苏墨点头，“他们两个去哪了？”
“他们觉得没事就去搜集食物了。”
严梅没了一开始时的那么活跃，可能是见到了苏墨一剑削掉丧尸的脑袋，让她说话也有些畏惧。
发了个消息给他们两人让他们回来汇合。
很快，两人就回来了。

来到了苏墨找到的这处小溪，溪水潺潺，赵敢当冲上去就洗了个脸。
“爽。”
也不管水能不能喝就喝了一大口下去。
苏墨提前升起了营火，把草搓成草绳，用树枝和草绳做了一个简单晾衣架。
来到小溪边，清洗身体，顺便把衣服简单揉搓一下，赵敢当在这溪里玩的不亦乐乎。
都说孩子天生喜欢水，水是万物之源，饱食度的作用只是暂时代替了饮水，只有苏墨知道，这个普通人面板也是有时间限制的。
大概是一年之后，饱食度只是一个显示，人还是会渴、会饱，目前只要是食物就可以一直吃下去，吃多少都没问题，这其实看起来像是——新手保护期。
四个人围在火堆旁取暖，在小溪里清洗一番舒服是舒服了，夜晚降临时该冷的还是逃不掉。
苏墨与赵敢当两人只穿了条裤衩坐在地上，赵敢当还有些不好意思，苏墨倒是不在意，只能说赵敢当的见识还是少了。
夜晚暗影降临后，只剩下营火才能给人带来一丝温暖，赵敢当这才从储物栏中拿出了一只鸡，苏墨眼中一亮，问：“刚抓来的？”
“对，还是婷姐发现的。”
赵敢当麻溜的将其处理一番，也得亏赵敢当会处理，不然也可以选择杀了掉落，估计会掉落一个鸡腿。
content_en:
"By the way, where is that Zheng Junxing?"
Only then did Zhao Gandang realize that one person was missing.
At first, the three of them were chased by zombies. When Su Mo came to support, only Su Ting and Yan Mei were running away.
"He has run away."
Su Ting spoke in a deep voice.
Zhao Gandang looked dissatisfied, "I knew he was not a good person and had no masculinity at all."
Su Mo didn't feel anything at all. He didn't shiver in order to survive.
In the apocalypse, even fratricide and the like are common.
After cleaning the battlefield, Zhao Gandang picked up the corpses of the zombies and threw them aside, intending to burn them, but Su Mo quickly stopped him.
"When zombies are burned, they will emit a foul smell, and the smell is very strong and will attract nearby zombies."
Explaining the reason to Zhao Gandang was equivalent to popular science. The meat on the zombies can be classified as carrion, and the smell of carrion can be imagined.
Seeing that another day was about to pass, Su Mo decided to find a place to build a campfire for the night. After a battle, everyone was a little tired, especially Su Ting and Yan Mei, who were chased by zombies all the way and couldn't walk at all.
Su Mo explored around alone and found a creek. He decided to stay next to the creek tonight.
By the time Su Mo returned, Yan Mei had already woken up. When she saw Su Mo, she forced a smile: "You, you are back."
"Well, we've already found a place to spend the night tonight."
Su Mo nodded, "Where did the two of them go?"
"They thought it was okay and went to collect food."
Yan Mei was not as active as she was at the beginning, maybe because she saw Su Mo cut off the zombie's head with a sword, which made her a little afraid to speak.
Sent a message to the two of them asking them to come back and meet up.
Soon, the two came back.
When they came to the creek that Su Mo found, Zhao Gandang rushed up and washed his face.
"It's cool."
I didn't care if the water was drinkable or not, so I took a big sip.
Su Mo lit up the campfire in advance, twisted the grass into straw ropes, and made a simple clothes drying rack out of branches and straw ropes.
When he came to the stream, he washed his body and rubbed his clothes briefly. Zhao Gandang had a great time playing in the stream.
It is said that children are born with a love for water. Water is the source of all things. The role of satiety is only a temporary replacement for drinking water. Only Su Mo knows that this ordinary person's panel also has a time limit.
About a year later, the satiety level is just an indicator. People will still be thirsty and full. At present, as long as it is food, they can continue to eat it. It doesn’t matter how much they eat. This actually looks like a protection period for novices.
The four of them gathered around the fire to keep warm, and they felt comfortable after washing themselves in the stream. When night fell, they still couldn't escape the cold.
Su Mo and Zhao Gandang were sitting on the ground wearing only a pair of underwear. Zhao Gandang was a little embarrassed, but Su Mo didn't care. It can only be said that Zhao Gandang still lacked knowledge.
After the shadows fell at night, only the campfire could bring a little warmth to people. Zhao Gandang took out a chicken from the storage column. Su Mo's eyes lit up and asked: "Did you just catch it?"
"Yes, Sister Ting discovered it."
Zhao Gan dealt with it quickly, but Zhao Gan had to be good at dealing with it. Otherwise, he could choose to kill it and drop it. It is estimated that a chicken leg would drop.
